title: DNS, domains and IP addresses
description: Understand domain names, URL components, address resolution and caching by building and testing a hostname inspection tool.
objectives: Separate URL origin, hostname, port and path
Explain recursive DNS lookup and the role of A and AAAA records
Inspect resolved IPv4 and IPv6 addresses with Node.js
Diagnose resolution errors without assuming a web server is down

sources.label: MDN: What is a domain name?

rubric: I separated the host and path of a URL with a non-default port.
I inspected localhost DNS resolution and explained address families.
I completed the lab and passed the deterministic DNS tests.
